column1: # AQL Language Specification: / modifiers on parens and dotted paths
# A `/` modifier on a parenthesised expression or a dotted path applies to
# the WHOLE group's result, not to the last key: `a.b/u` parses as
# `(a get b)/u` ≡ `(a get b) usurp`. (Usurp calls a retrieved function
# value, reversing its signature arg order.)
# §1  /u usurps the function retrieved by a dotted path
# §3  a dotted path with no modifier auto-dispatches the function as before

column3: no modifier: the grouped function still auto-dispatches
